en:
## New Features

- Plugins can contribute web search channels that the search router treats like any built-in one
- Much wider plugin theming: 22 styleable regions, nine-slice frames and per-scheme variants, with three worked examples
- Plugin providers now receive host hints, so they reach upstream through the host's proxy instead of failing in proxy-only environments
- Native web search is on by default for official-API Claude providers, and can be turned off per provider

## Bug Fixes

- Prompt caching against relays now actually hits instead of only ever writing: the official Claude path was sending a per-request proof value inside the cached prefix, which invalidated the whole prefix every turn. Request shape was corrected field by field against real captures, so a long session no longer gets billed at full input each turn
- Native search moved to a separate one-shot side request, because declaring the server-side search tool on the main request made relays drop the cache breakpoints entirely
- Codex requests now present one consistent client fingerprint across all three transports (HTTP chat, Responses WebSocket and one-shot utility calls); WebSocket request diagnostics recorded hardcoded placeholder data rather than what was actually sent
- The WebSocket request dump wrote the Authorization header verbatim, leaking a real Codex OAuth token into persisted diagnostics
- A plugin-contributed search channel was silently dropped on every restart, which also re-enabled a channel you had turned off and moved it to the end of the fallback order
- A plugin's declared output-size limit was never enforced, so a source promising a small response got the full host budget
- Visible reasoning could disappear from Codex sessions because the shared request contract omitted the summary field the API needs to emit those events
- A failed mid-flight search now surfaces as an error so the next fallback runs, instead of reporting a confident "no results"
- The WebSearch tool is no longer offered to models whose provider has no usable search channel
- Update checks no longer stall the server for a moment on the first poll after a download: verifying the new binary hashed ~100MB synchronously on the request path
- The update check and version endpoints required no authentication at all
- Two test suites leaked process-global state and broke 20 unrelated tests whenever the suite ran as a whole; both now fail to typecheck if a global or module mock is registered without its cleanup

## Refactoring

- Codex client headers now follow the API mode instead of a separate toggle, which previously produced a request shape no real client sends
- Retired the plugin trust-tier axis, which could never move off its most restrictive value and so only ever meant "nothing may activate"
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 插件可以贡献网络搜索通道，搜索路由会像对待内置通道一样使用它们
- 大幅扩展插件主题能力：22 个可定制区域、九宫格边框、按明暗方案的变体，并附三个完整示例
- 插件提供商现在会收到宿主的代理提示，在仅能走代理的环境中不再直接失败
- 官方 API 形态的 Claude 供应商默认开启原生网络搜索，可按供应商单独关闭

## 修复

- 经中转站的 prompt 缓存终于能命中，而不是只写入从不读取：官方 Claude 路径此前会在缓存前缀内塞入一个每轮都变的证明值，导致整段前缀每轮失效。现已依据真实抓包逐字段校正请求形态，长会话不再每轮按全量输入计费
- 原生搜索改为独立的一次性副请求——在主请求上声明服务端搜索工具会让中转站直接丢掉缓存断点
- Codex 的三条传输路径（HTTP 聊天、Responses WebSocket、一次性工具调用）现在呈现一致的客户端指纹；WebSocket 的请求诊断此前记录的是硬编码占位数据，与实际发送内容不符
- 修复 WebSocket 请求转储原样写入 Authorization 头，导致真实 Codex OAuth 令牌被写进持久化诊断的问题
- 修复插件贡献的搜索通道每次重启都被静默丢弃的问题——它还会把你关掉的通道重新打开，并挪到 fallback 顺序末尾
- 修复插件声明的输出大小上限从未生效的问题：承诺只返回少量内容的来源实际拿到了完整的宿主配额
- 修复 Codex 会话可见思考可能消失的问题：共享请求契约漏了 API 下发这些事件所需的 summary 字段
- 搜索中途失败现在会正确报错并顺延到下一个 fallback，而不是报告一个自信的「无结果」
- 不再向所在供应商没有可用搜索通道的模型提供 WebSearch 工具
- 下载更新后的首次检查不再让服务器短暂卡顿：校验新二进制此前会在请求路径上同步哈希约 100MB 数据
- 修复更新检查与版本查询接口完全不需要认证的问题
- 修复两个测试套件泄漏进程级全局状态、导致整体运行时 20 个无关测试失败的问题；现在注册全局变量或模块 mock 却不登记清理会直接编译失败

## 重构

- Codex 客户端请求头改为随 API 模式变化，不再由独立开关控制——后者会产出任何真实客户端都不会发送的请求形态
- 移除插件信任等级机制：它永远无法脱离最严格的档位，实际含义只是「任何插件都不能启用」
